subject: HMC Swindles kickoff - cheaper posterior inference for the platform
body:
Team,

Kicking off the HMC Swindles workstream. Our open-source release showed you can substantially cut the variance of Hamiltonian Monte Carlo estimates with a couple of well-chosen 'swindles', and it ships a clean four-step pipeline: train the NeuTra preconditioner, tune the sampler, benchmark, evaluate. The product angle for data-platforms: a hardened posterior-inference service that internal teams can use for calibrated uncertainty on pipeline metrics without hand-tuning samplers.

Milestones across our (long) window: pipeline repro on the shipped tune_outputs hyperparameters by end of March, our own tuning loop by mid-May, then a full benchmark sweep in late June and a decision memo by 2026-07-13.

Wei owns methodology, Paloma the pipeline hardening, Leilani and Oyin infra and the benchmark harness hookup. Deshawn - resourcing note when you can; the June sweep is the only big compute item.

Dmitri
